name: Hippogryph Muisek
summary: Hippogryph Muisek preserves the spirits of the Frayfeather hippogryphs in Feralas. Witch Doctor Uzer'i asks you to capture them with a Muisek Vessel.

sections.title: Spirits Preserved
sections.body: Among the Frayfeather hippogryphs of the High Wilderness, you are to capture ten with the Muisek Vessel. The night elves have long kept hippogryphs as loyal companions, and their spirits are steadfast. The vessel preserves each spirit after its creature is slain.

faq.answer: Hippogryph Muisek is the preserved spirit of a Frayfeather hippogryph, captured in a Muisek Vessel.

faq.q: Where do I find Frayfeather hippogryphs?
faq.answer: Frayfeather hippogryphs live in the High Wilderness, south of Witch Doctor Uzer'i, who asks you to capture them.
Uzer'i wants their muisek preserved, since a spirit left free after its creature dies may take the form of a greater creature and threaten those nearby.
Uzer'i asks you to capture ten Frayfeather hippogryphs.

angles.text: As a night elf, you know hippogryphs as loyal companions whose spirits are steadfast. Uzer'i's concern is to preserve those spirits safely.
